prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Survival Arena field-selection thumbnail. Primary request: the fortified heart of the royal citadel combining an inner courtyard, ceremonial halls, and armored passageways. Scene/backdrop: monumental stone walls, heavy columns, vaulted galleries, portcullis passages and royal banners without readable emblems. Subject: constrained routes with fewer open safe zones, alternating a stern courtyard and covered ceremonial corridors; a massive crown-shaped gate silhouette as landmark without literal text. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn stylized storybook cutout environment illustration; flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular ink outlines, matte colors, simple cel shading, subtle paper texture; warm ironic fairy-tale danger; not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, readable 3/4 top-down overview, clear traversable routes and obstacle rhythm, one strong environmental focal landmark, foreground framing kept subtle, works when center-cropped and downscaled to a 170-pixel-high UI card. Lighting/mood: austere late-afternoon light with controlled dramatic shadows, still fully readable. Color palette: cool gray stone, deep navy, muted crimson, aged gold. Constraints: environment only; no characters, enemies, creatures, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark; no close-up object; no map labels; preserve broad open gameplay space. Avoid: ruined castle, battlefield debris, gothic horror, excessively dark interiors.
